scope: All six reviewer outcomes collected; targeted owner fixes verified independently.

resolutions.title: Check output existence before overwriting acceptance metadata
resolutions.resolution: Root reserved a fresh label before any output, added per-run acceptance declaration, and preserved historical runner. Independent copied-index run rejects existing output without mutation; fresh 441-case / 262144-frame run passes with matching declaration digest.

resolutions.title: Return failure when candidate acceptance gates fail
resolutions.resolution: Root makes the real main exit 1 after writing a false acceptance receipt. Synthetic leaf stubs exercise actual aggregation/output/exit logic: old false exits 0; fixed false exits 1; fixed true exits 0. No DSP or compiler executes in this status control.

resolutions.title: Allow public-boundary checks to consume fresh review outputs
resolutions.resolution: Root added explicit review directory selection, required three libraries, and exclusive receipt writing. Independent 130-case run passes from the previously compiled private fresh label; repeat and missing-library negatives reject with no prior-result mutation.

resolutions.title: Truncated fixtures still produce pinned acceptance receipts
resolutions.resolution: Root validates the exact three declared reference SHA256s before reserving output and records actual verified hashes. Unchanged references pass and retain 5120 endpoints. Truncated CSV, one-byte JSON/brief changes, missing CSV, and incomplete declaration all reject before output or compiler; pre-fix truncated control demonstrates four endpoints can otherwise pass. This probes orchestration using retained curves and stubbed nonreference leaves, not a new full DSP acceptance run.

testing_gap_followup.coverage: Cached running attack/release, following decay uses changed duration/sustain, immediate live sustain; amplitude and independently owned filter.
